constraints: NEVER write data/sites.json — a second session owns it (batches 22-24 in flight).
NEVER auto-edit published facts (CLAUDE.md rule 5, guardrail G9). Reports and review queues only.
NEVER fill a field from model memory (CLAUDE.md rule 2, guardrail G2). Omit instead.
NEVER merge or push to main — it auto-deploys production. PRs into develop only.
New gate rules land warn-only until the other session's merges are complete.
Data session owns data/**; product session owns src/**, scripts/, schema. Hand data work over via docs/SCRAPING_BRIEFS.md.
